title: Inventory and Wardrobe
author: Theo Oyelaran
blurb: Bram Winterbourne, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
